body:
Added a synthesized 808 (pitch-drop 220->52Hz + tanh saturation, 1.5s decay) to demo_content.mjs's makeKit(), landing at pad index 5 / slot 6 on dj.html's 16-pad MIDI sampler -- previously the first empty capture-only pad. Live-verified via Playwright against mixforge.okemily.com/dj.html: pad 6 shows label '808', clicking it fires note-on routed to pad 6 with zero console errors. dsp_test.mjs (49 assertions) still passes. Commit MIXFORGE@3ea08c7.

⚓ ☃
title: MPC pad slot 6: real 808 sub bass/kick added
